description: Dump Virtual #field rect for coord debug

params.expression: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('field'); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({ x: r.x, y: r.y, w: r.width, h: r.height, cx: r.x + r.width / 2, cy: r.y + r.height / 2, vw: window.innerWidth, vh: window.innerHeight }); })()
